title: Paint rake range
proposal: Original design proposal, not a claim of observed game or reference-site behavior. Make a range control a scraped paint path with a toothed rake thumb protruding beyond the track. proposal: Original design proposal, not a claim of observed game or reference-site behavior. Give each destination one name on a diagonal elastic band. The selected band's backing stretches into the margin and recoils when the visitor moves on. Choose type that fits the complete name at phone width.
